svg.title: One event, several clocks
svg.desc: Proposed physical timing-validation diagram. Software intent, stream marker timestamps, display rendering, optical onset detection and EEG acquisition are distinct. The optical-pickup route is schematic and requires verified hardware compatibility. Timelines and repeated-event diagrams are illustrative, with no measured latency or jitter asserted.
